Hi Ben — apologies for the late note. We've had a roadmap reprioritization here: our product leadership just locked in a two-week engineering sprint to hit an analytics milestone that pulls most of Jordan's and some of my bandwidth into Q4. Because of that, we need to pause new vendor-led demos while we get through the sprint.

Request: can we put the Redwood demo on a tentative hold and revisit scheduling in early January 2027? If helpful, I attached the internal roadmap excerpt that shows the sprint window. We still intend to evaluate LLM/inference in our stack, but it's shifted down our priority list until the analytics milestone is stable.

I realize this is not ideal timing — happy to pick back up when we have bandwidth.

Thanks for understanding,
Ari
